title: Mixed Event — An Unmissable Spirited Affair — Episode6 Until The Finish Line

meta.Event Outline: Kamiyama High School's second-years are headed to Kyoto! In contrast with Tsukasa's excitement for their school trip, Rui is less enthused. But will his feelings change when one of his classmates approaches him?

rows.Line: Hyakki Yako Parade Venue

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This really is such a large crowd...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It is one of this season's most famous events. As such, tourists from all over flock to see it, including us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... Based on this flyer...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The general participants appear first, then people wearing costumes and stuff designed by professionals.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you can even join on the day by renting a costume...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! Is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, that may be difficult.
I just saw a sign towards the entrance that said, “All costumes have been rented out.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, darn it...!
If only I paid closer attention to what that website said...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I feel the same way...
We could've all been in it...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure I would've wanted to...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: But I kinda wish you guys could be in it, Kamishiro! I bet it'd be great!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree.
The parade would be guaranteed to be more fun if Tsukasa and Kamishiro were able to participate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I feel even more regretful about not being able to take part...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But the rules are the rules...
So, let's just enjoy it as regular tourists!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At the same time, that's going to be hard with this many people around. I feel we should move somewhere less crowded...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then... How about over there?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Try to stay together, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's—

rows.Speaker: Parade Participants
rows.Line:
Excuse us!
Heavy load coming through!

rows.Speaker: Nice Old Lady
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
They're going to hit that old lady...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Nice Old Lady
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you for protecting me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I'm just glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But it's not safe here. There's far too many people... We need to find somewhere less crowded to take refuge—)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My phone...! I dropped it...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Oh no, it cracked.
But this old lady takes priority right now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you hurt, Kamishiro?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hinomori...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Madam, would you like us to help you move somewhere less crowded? If we can get back to the main boulevard...

rows.Speaker: Nice Old Lady
rows.Line: No, that's okay. My friend should be waiting for me just over there. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That's a relief...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But please be careful. This crowd is making even walking difficult.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness she ended up being okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm just as glad.
Now, we should get back to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, where did Airi and the others go...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Did we get separated from them...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We need to contact them and...
...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's no use.
The touch screen on my phone's unresponsive after I dropped it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wh-What should we do...?!
My phone has no battery left...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
We can look for a place to charge it!
Any convenience store should do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Let's look for one while keeping our ears open for Tsukasa's voice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may just hear him shouting our names somewhere along the way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui!!!
Shizuku!!!
Where are you two?!?!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Kamishiro!
Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi & Taniyama
rows.Line: Where are you?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Say something if you can hear us!!
Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think our voices are being drowned out by the music and all these other people...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
To think that they're unable to hear my booming voice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can't reach Shizuku because her phone has no charge, but I don't understand why we can't get ahold of Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I don't know either...
I hope they weren't swept away somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are they going to be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that sound...
I think the parade is about to begin...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not good...! Once it starts, more people will gather to watch it! That's only gonna make it harder for us to find them...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to locate them now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, their safety is a top priority...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But this is also our school trip.
Our goal is to watch this parade together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's keep looking for them!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi!
Asahina!
Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi—
*Cough*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes... It's just my throat...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's stop here. You shouldn't overstrain your voice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
Still, now that the parade is underway, it seems like there are more people here. What if we can't find the others?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
Won't it become easier to find them after it's over?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After it's over...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, she's right...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You only get one chance in life as a high schooler to go on this trip! It's like a one-night-only performance!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But it would be nice to have you in our group, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind if we resumed our search?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A school trip... It's akin to a one-night-only performance...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like to see the finale as a complete group.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, me too...
You're exactly right, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd also like to create as many wonderful memories as I can with everyone. And more importantly...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi and the others are very likely still trying their best to find us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you're probably right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, should be doing the same!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Agreed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But shouting may not be doing us any good since this crowd seems to be drowning us out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If only there were a better way for us to get Tsukasa and the others to notice us...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Whoa!
That nurikabe looks so real!

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Same with that nurarihyon...
Their makeup looks professionally done.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, the costumes...

rows.Speaker: Tourists
rows.Line:
Cool! Check out that red ogre!
It totally stands out with that giant club!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It stands out...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Last call for joining the parade with your own costume!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's it...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hinomori, I have an idea, but I need your help.
Would you mind hearing me out?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?
